title: Rafael and the Debt
author: Lior Marchetti
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
